title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
text: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.

title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
text: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.

title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
text: The AI lab's personal assistant is an operating system from the future designed to compete with Muse, Dots, and Instinct.

title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior
text: Mirror Particle will launch at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a world model built from scratch to predict human behavior, arguing that LLM role-play falls short for market research and brand strategy.

title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
text: "We created this program because we believe the benefits of AI will reach most people through the companies that build on top of models, rather than through the models alone."

title: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
text: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

title: LibreOffice says ‘no AI’ is now a software feature
text: The maker of the open source document editor says it has no plans to add AI to its software's default configuration, citing user privacy.

title: Mistral’s new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
text: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.

title: Pinterest’s AI now turns beauty Pins into action plans
text: Pinterest’s new AI-powered Beauty Guides translate hair and nail Pins into salon terminology, with estimated costs, appointment times, and maintenance needs.

title: Get all your questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: The full breakout session agenda revealed
text: Get all of your scaling and tech questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Here's the full breakout session agenda, happening October 13-15 in San Francisco. Register now to join and save up to $100, and get a second pass at 50% off.

title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
text: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
text: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost

title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
text: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share

title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
text: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.

title: Hot Girl Hotline is like ‘Dear Abby’ for the AI era
text: Founded by two sisters, Hot Girl Hotline uses AI to give young women personalized dating and relationship advice, with an emphasis on safety and avoiding emotional dependency.

title: HackerRank’s AI interviewer offers a glimpse into what job interviews could become
text: HackerRank’s AI interviewer has already conducted more than 500,000 interviews, with Snowflake, Snorkel, and Capgemini among its early testers.

title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
text: The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.
